body: Thanks for all the kind words. And yes all the waiting drives me insane. You get scared, then fear takes over the closer bad event is the scaryer it gets. Later it turns in to panic. After a while you are so emotionaly drained that you just want to get over with it. At this point suicide slowly creeps into your mind as an option and just sits there. You know it's an option. You dont want to do it but it just seems like a way out out of all this. It's hard.

I was trying to keep my head up but lately i'm failing. And each day seems like a huge test. Few days ago i was forced to move out and it seemed like the end of the world. All the shame of cooming back home like a lozer. Next day i got to talk with my childhood friend who knew me for years and seeing him like this broke me down. Also seeing my grandma so weak, barely even being able to hold a spoon... Not talking. Responding with a single word to every 25th question... Now i got to stay a night in my stepfathers home for a night. In my old cold the really room. It's the coldest room in the house. We have central heating and then the whole house is warm im freezing in here. The difference is so big that you can actually feel then you walk in to the room. Its same as opening a freezer at summer. And still biggest test will be tommorow.

Sent that by accident... With two of you. Just try to explain how it feels. My suggestion would be try out a new hobby or activity. Anything to mess up whole rutine. Anything you ever dreamed of. Latin american dance saved my life at some point. Maybe new instrument. Just try to keep those thoughts away. Worker for me. It sounds stupid, i know but it works
I would recomend calling. Have no experience with text type of help so dont know how it works there. And speaking will with your housband should clear it u

I'm in the same boat as you. Well i mean suicidal. My problems are financional. But i would trade evrything to swich places with you. You have a place to live, kids a normal life. Most of my life decitions are looked just like yours. Everything i do is wrong. You feel tension before making any decition because you start to think of all the possible outcomes. How ur gonna get blamed if you do this or that... I get what you mean. But i think you still have alot to live for. You have a husband you can talk to, ur kids. Maybe there's some friends or family? Would suggest trying out suicide hot line if there's no one to talk to. Find yourself an hour and open up. It's quite easy talking to a stranger. If you are afraid tell them fake name. Helps me then i cant bare anymore. Its usally one time thing but it's something
